gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-multani: Retro and friendly, Junegull leads in tubular, wire-like letters. And Noto Sans Multani, a sans-serif with a tall x-height and a wide gap in its e, keeps the text moving.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-old-per: Junegull brings retro, friendly display letters with no hairlines and no shadows. And Noto Sans Old Permic reads softly underneath, rounded and open, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Junegull is all retro friendliness with pinched curves and no light-heavy flicker. Yet the real hook is Noto Sans Rejang, a sans-serif whose wide porthole counters let the text breathe.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-samarit: Junegull is closed, retro, and friendly, with tight pinched curves. Noto Sans Samaritan, with daylight inside its curves and a hefty lowercase, gives those tight shapes an open partner on the page.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-saurash: Junegull plays retro and friendly, its lowercase standing tall like cast iron capitals. Noto Sans Saurashtra keeps its counters connected to the outside, so the text stays light beside it.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-sc: No stress in any curve, and that is Junegull all over. It does closed display shapes best, while Noto Sans SC, a modern sans, does its best work with open chalk curves.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Noto Sans Siddham brings a big central band and an s with far-hanging ends. But Junegull, retro and closed in its shapes, gives that openness a friendly frame above.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Friendly and retro, Junegull pinches every curve nearly shut. Noto Sans Soyombo, a sans-serif with a sizable x-height and wide, unclosed mouths, keeps screen text flowing smoothly line after line underneath.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Open, daylit curves make the text read smoothly, a clear foil to the closed, retro forms of Junegull. Noto Sans Sunuwar keeps short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies, so a page goes down without tiring.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-syloti-: Retro through and through, Junegull keeps its o equally thick all round. It does closed display shapes best, while Noto Sans Syloti Nagri, a sans-serif with short ascenders, does open reading text best.
